text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim against driverless cars from the opening sentence","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states its stance immediately and keeps that position unmistakable throughout."},{"evidence":"repeated warnings about internet failure, accidents, and blame","quality":"reasoned support","description":"The essay develops its argument with multiple linked reasons rather than mostly listing ideas."},{"evidence":"quotation of the article's liability question","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay directly incorporates a detail from the source to support its point."},{"evidence":"counterpoint about cars not being fully driverless","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay explains why the article's limits on the technology matter to its overall conclusion."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs that revisit the same thesis in different ways","quality":"organizational coherence","description":"The essay is structured around a consistent line of argument that is easier to follow."}]}
